info.name: Construction.Account.Admin Account Management Issue Attribute Definitions API

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of custom attribute definitions to return in the response payload. For example, limit=2. Acceptable values: 1-200. Default value: 200.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of custom attribute definitions you want to begin retrieving results from.

params.name: filter[createdAt]
params.description: Retrieves items that were created at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[updatedAt]
params.description: Retrieves items that were last updated at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[deletedAt]
params.description: Retrieves types that were deleted at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[dataType]
params.description: Retrieves issue custom attribute definitions with the specified data type. Possible values: list (this corresponds to dropdown in the UI), text, paragraph, numeric. For example, filter[dataType]=text,numeric.

items.docs: Retrieves information about issue custom attributes (custom fields) for a project, including the custom attribute title, description and type.
